question: Should completion delivery continue to accept incomplete account evidence for otherwise matching non-threaded routes while requiring exact account and thread evidence for threaded routes?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility boundary between avoiding false visible-delivery success and preserving established integrations that may not report complete account metadata; source review cannot determine the permanent product contract alone.

options.title: Confirm the split compatibility rule
options.body: Keep strict account-and-thread matching for threaded requester routes while retaining the current non-threaded omitted-account compatibility behavior, then rebase and validate it.

options.title: Require account evidence everywhere
options.body: Treat a missing observed account as insufficient for all account-bound routes, accepting the resulting fallback or failure behavior as a deliberate compatibility change.

options.title: Pause for a broader delivery-contract design
options.body: Defer this PR if maintainers want one shared route-evidence contract across completion delivery, route merging, and provider outcome serialization before changing runtime accounting.

recommendation.title: Confirm the split compatibility rule
recommendation.body: Keep strict account-and-thread matching for threaded requester routes while retaining the current non-threaded omitted-account compatibility behavior, then rebase and validate it.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged account-bound route work is the nearest current-main ownership signal for deciding how account identity participates in delivery-route matching.
